findings.title: Saved custom wrap pair is ignored by remapped symbol keys
findings.reproduction: SOURCE PROJECTION, not AHK execution: wrap feature and hashtag_quote roll enabled, builtin # enabled; use actual two-step Add custom menu with # and ~ and accept successful persistence. Select alpha in supported UIA editor, ensure preceding output is not ( or [, press AltGr+SC017 without layer Shift. Registered HashtagOrQuote calls WrapTextIfSelected("#","#","#") and sends #alpha# rather than committed #alpha~. Standard OS-layout prefix route reads active custom map correctly.
findings.root_cause: Custom commit publishes current active pair after builtins, but remapped WrapTextIfSelected uses its concrete built-in bound delimiters and only checks disabled-left, never current active pair; final successful SendInstant does not come back through prefix wrapping.
findings.silent_failure: Output succeeds with the older built-in pair; menu label and live/durable custom map correctly advertise #…~ and no exception/refusal occurs.
findings.regression_test: Actual AHK Add-custom dialogs/private acknowledged persistence -> registered remap chain -> faithful selection and recorded final sender; compare no-override, custom collision, remove/reload, disabled/refused commit, and OS-layout prefix routes. Verify target receiving separately.
findings.basis: Actual business-owner replay over explicit native boundaries; Windows source contract only. See evidence and limitations in source report.

findings.title: UIA selection prefix is wrapped as though it were the complete selection
findings.reproduction: SOURCE PROJECTION, not AHK execution: select 8192 ASCII a characters plus trailing Z in UIA TextPattern editor other than excluded Code.exe; allow valid current worker result, consume within750ms, press real mapped # wrapper with no roll prefix. Worker GetText(8192) returns prefix only, reports ok, cache/consumer forwards it, wrapper pastes #+prefix+# over entire8193-character selection, losing Z. Under-limit healthy and stale/refused controls differ.
findings.root_cause: Bounded UIA GetText limit8192 is treated as complete selection with no range-length/completeness/truncated status. The parent snapshot validates context and age only; replacement spans full selected native range.
findings.silent_failure: Nonempty bounded Body is normal ok; no truncation observer in worker, wire payload, parent publication, consumer or wrapper. Existing timeout/failed/stale warnings never run; successful native paste cannot recover omitted suffix.
findings.regression_test: Preserve bounded worker/deadline and add bounded completeness detection/refusal. Genuine AHK worker facade with faithful TextPattern maxLength -> parent cache -> single-use consumer -> public wrapper; test8191/8192/8193, Unicode/CRLF, current/stale/canceled/timeout and exact receiving/undo separately. No unbounded GetText(-1).
findings.basis: Actual business-owner replay over explicit native boundaries; Windows source contract only. See evidence and limitations in source report.
